name: genpark-personal-agent-apolipoprotein-b-a1-atherogenic-skill
title: Apolipoprotein B/A1 Ratio & Atherogenic Particle Sentinel Skill
description: ApoB / ApoA1 atherogenic particle ratio, non-HDL discordance analysis, small dense LDL-P proxy, and cardiovascular plaque risk reduction. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).
